about: meta QA 11-25 rows 82 and 119: script paths that point where nothing is, still carried, each with why its fix is not this repo's; shrink only (node .githooks/script-paths.mjs --prune).

findings.finding: scripts/blender/: stray in scripts/ (src/scripts/ is the lean home: move it under src/, or baseline why it stays)
findings.why: The SDK's Blender build (node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/blender/build.sh) reads its manifest at ./scripts/blender/targets.json from the repo root, and its driftwood-isle/island and fp-arms targets build models here here; the folder moves under src/ when the SDK's build reads it there (sharddev's change).
